tagline.en: MeiGen-AI's long-horizon world model — navigate a scene from a single image and generate extended, memory-consistent video.
tagline.zh: MeiGen-AI 的长时程世界模型——从单张图片出发在场景中导航,生成带记忆一致性的长视频。

en: Infinite-World, from MeiGen-AI, is an interactive world model built for long-horizon generation. From a single conditioning image it lets you navigate a scene and keeps generating video well beyond a short clip.
Its design emphasizes memory, so the world stays consistent as the sequence extends over a long horizon. It works as an image-to-video model with interactive navigation, released as code and weights.
In WorldFoundry it runs as a world / video task — provide a starting image and navigation input, and it produces a long-horizon world video together with preview metadata.
zh: Infinite-World 由 MeiGen-AI 开发,是一个面向长时程生成的交互式世界模型。从一张条件图片出发,它让你在场景中导航,并能持续生成远超短片的视频。
其设计强调记忆,使世界在序列延展到长时程时仍保持一致。它以带交互导航的图生视频方式工作,并以代码加权重形式发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以世界/视频任务运行——提供一张起始图片和导航输入,它便产出长时程的世界视频以及预览元数据。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Infinite-World when you want to explore a scene interactively from a single image and generate extended video that stays coherent over a long horizon.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片交互式探索场景、并生成在长时程内保持连贯的长视频时,可以选择 Infinite-World。

notFor.en: It needs the checkpoint and a capable GPU, and its focus is image-conditioned long-horizon navigation rather than free-form text-to-video.
notFor.zh: 它需要 checkpoint 与足够的 GPU,重点在于图像条件的长时程导航,而非自由的文生视频。

en: Long-horizon world generation from a single image
Memory-consistent scene as the sequence extends
zh: 从单张图片进行长时程世界生成
序列延展时保持记忆一致的场景
